reviews.text: If you want a change in your skin and hide facial pigmentation, you should use Vitamin C5 every morning for clear skin. Of course, results do not appear immediately after using it for a full week. The difference becomes clear and I recommend it. I bought 4 boxes.
reviews.zh: 如果你想改善皮膚，同遮蓋面部色素沉著，就應該每朝用 Vitamin C5，令皮膚更加通透。當然，用咗成個星期都唔會即時見到效果。差異會慢慢變得明顯，我推薦。我買咗 4 盒。

reviews.text: This was recommended to me by an acupuncturist who does microneedling for its potency. If you like strong vitamin C serums and don't mind a citrus-y scent, this product is great! Wouldn't say it's for beginners - def for someone who is already seasoned to using vitamin C in their routine
reviews.zh: 呢款係由一位會做微針療程嘅針灸師推薦畀我嘅，因為佢功效強。如果你鍾意效果較強嘅維他命 C 精華，又唔介意柑橘味，呢款就好好！我唔會話佢適合初學者，絕對係適合已經熟習使用維他命 C 嘅人。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Anua Green Lemon Vita C Blemish Serum for a couple of weeks now, and I’m honestly loving the results! I have combination skin with some dark spots and occasional breakouts. This serum really helped brighten my skin and even out my tone. It feels light and fresh, and it doesn’t sting or
 cause any irritation, which is a big plus for me.
Thank you, Anua, for creating such a gentle yet effective product! It’s now a must-have in my skincare routine. 🍋✨
reviews.zh:
我用咗 Anua Green Lemon Vita C Blemish Serum 幾個星期，真係好鍾意個效果！我皮膚係混合性，有啲暗瘡印，偶爾會爆痘。呢款精華真係幫我提亮膚色、均勻膚色。質地清爽、輕盈，唔會刺痛或者
引起任何刺激，對我嚟講係一大優點。
多謝 Anua 研發出咁溫和又有效嘅產品！而家已經係我護膚步驟入面必備嘅一樣。🍋✨

reviews.text: The Anua Green Lemon Vitamin C Serum is praised for its effectiveness in reducing dark spots and brightening skin due to its high concentration of lemon extract and vitamin C. Users report a visible improvement in skin tone within a month, along with reduced pigmentation. However, it has a short shelf life and requires refrigeration, which can be inconvenient. The serum has a slightly sticky texture and a lemony scent, which some find refreshing but may not appeal to everyone. Despite these limitations, it’s valued for its potent results.
reviews.zh: Anua Green Lemon Vitamin C Serum 因為含有高濃度嘅檸檬萃取同維他命 C，而備受好評，認為佢可以減淡暗瘡印、提亮膚色。用家反映一個月內膚色有明顯改善，色素沉澱亦有所減少。不過，佢嘅保存期限較短，而且需要冷藏，可能會有啲唔方便。精華質地微黏，有檸檬香味，有人覺得清新，但未必人人都接受。儘管有呢啲限制，佢嘅強效功效仍然好受重視。

reviews.text:
The best serum I have tried 

It will be one of my best purchases and I will use it constantly. I hope that its ingredients do not change because it is very excellent on the skin. When used more than once, it makes the skin radiant all the time.

佢會係我最好嘅購物之一，我會經常用。希望佢嘅成分唔好改，因為佢對皮膚好好。用咗多過一次之後，皮膚會一直都好有光澤。

reviews.text: One of the best things about the serum is the fact that the bottle isn't transparent, which adds longevity to the serum. It has amazing texture, feels light on the skin, and I already see some improvement in my skintone after using it! It's fantastic!
reviews.zh: 呢款精華其中一個最好嘅地方，係個樽唔透光，有助延長精華嘅保存期。質地好好，塗落去感覺輕盈，用咗之後我已經見到膚色有啲改善！非常好！

reviews.text: Second time purchasing it, because it is by far the most effective vitamin C I've tried. In comparison to others I've used, this one faded dark spots in 2 months' time, and another advantage is that it absorbs better than others. The smell is, of course, off putting for some people, but hey, all pure forms of vitamin C smell like iron. Anyway, if not sensitive to smell, it is worth buying.
reviews.zh: 呢次係第二次買，因為佢係我試過最有效嘅維他命 C。同我用過嘅其他產品比較，呢款兩個月就令暗瘡印減淡咗，另一個優點係吸收得比其他產品好。當然，個味令一啲人唔舒服，不過話返轉頭，所有純維他命 C 嘅味道都係咁，好似鐵嘅味。總之，如果你唔敏感於氣味，就值得買。
